units.source_text: “倒也是啊。

en.t: That is true enough.

units.source_text: 不过，你毕竟家里有钱，才说得这样轻松。

en.t: But after all, your family has money, so you can say it so lightly.

units.source_text: 你看那些穷人家的孩子，就不能像你这么不急不慌的了。”

en.t: Look at children from poor families, and they cannot stay as calm and unhurried as you do.

units.source_text: 我的同学中，有的人还没毕业就在寻找中学教员的工作了。

en.t: Among my classmates, some were already looking for jobs as middle school teachers before graduation.

units.source_text: 我心里认可夫人说的话，嘴上却说：

en.t: Inwardly I accepted what she said, but aloud I said:

units.source_text: “大概是有点受先生的影响吧。”

en.t: I suppose I have been influenced a little by Sensei.

units.source_text: “他没有给你好影响啊。”

en.t: He has not had a good influence on you.

units.source_text: 先生苦笑着说：

en.t: Sensei said with a bitter smile:

units.source_text: “受我影响也没关系，不过，以前我跟你说过，

en.t: It is all right if you are influenced by me, but as I told you before,

units.source_text: 趁你父亲活着的时候，一定要把财产分到手。

en.t: while your father is still alive, you must make sure to get your share of the property.

units.source_text: 没有分到手的话，也绝不可疏忽大意。”

en.t: If you do not get it settled, you must never let your guard down.

units.source_text: 我想起在那杜鹃花盛开的五月初，和先生在郊外苗圃的宽敞院落里的谈话；

en.t: I remembered my conversation with Sensei in the spacious garden of a nursery in the suburbs at the beginning of May, when the azaleas were in bloom;

units.source_text: 耳边又反复响起先生在回来的路上，以亢奋的语气对我讲的那番可怕的话。

en.t: and the terrible words Sensei had spoken to me in an excited tone on the way back rang again and again in my ears.

units.source_text: 他的话岂止是可怕，简直是令人震撼，

en.t: His words were more than frightening; they were positively shocking,

units.source_text: 但是对于不明真相的我来说，也是半途而废的谈话。

en.t: but to me, not knowing the truth, the conversation also felt unfinished and unresolved.

units.source_text: “夫人，您家的财产很多吗？”

en.t: Madam, does your family have a great deal of property?

units.source_text: “你怎么问起这种事？”

en.t: Why do you ask such a thing?

units.source_text: “问先生也不告诉我嘛。”

en.t: Because Sensei will not tell me when I ask him.

units.source_text: “大概不值得告诉你吧。”夫人笑着瞧了瞧先生。

en.t: Perhaps it is not worth telling you, she said, smiling and glancing at Sensei.

units.source_text: “请您告诉我，大概需要多少财产才能过先生这样的生活。

en.t: Please tell me about how much property one needs to live the way Sensei does.

units.source_text: 我回家跟父亲谈判时，也好作个参考。”

en.t: Then when I go home and negotiate with my father, I can use it as a reference.

units.source_text: 先生面向庭院，若无其事地抽着烟。

en.t: Sensei faced the garden and smoked as if nothing were the matter.

units.source_text: 我自然只好问夫人了。

en.t: Naturally, I had no choice but to ask his wife.
